```{r}
#| label: load-data-9001-OECD
#| echo: false

# ── ISO 9001 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
sheets <- c(4, 5, 6, 7, 8)
sheets_9001 <- purrr::map(sheets, ~ read_excel(
  "data/01. ISO 9001 - Number of certificates per country and industry sectors - 1993 to 2017.xlsm",
  sheet = .x
))

sheets_9001[[2]] <- sheets_9001[[2]] %>% slice(-(39:42))
sheets_9001[[4]] <- sheets_9001[[4]] %>% slice(-(36:40))
sheets_9001[[3]] <- sheets_9001[[3]] %>% dplyr::select(-27)
my_names <- c("country", as.character(1993:2017))

iso9001 <- purrr::map(1:5, ~ sheets_9001[[.x]] %>%
  slice(-(1:2)) %>%
  set_names(my_names) %>%
  pivot_longer(-country, names_to = "year", values_to = "n_cert")) %>%
  reduce(bind_rows) %>%
  mutate(country = case_match(country,
    "United States of America" ~ "United States",
    "Korea, Republic of" ~ "Korea",
    "Slovakia" ~ "Slovak Republic",
    .default = country
  )) %>%
  filter(country %in% oecd) %>%
  mutate(
    id     = as.integer(factor(country, levels = sort(unique(country)))),
    n_cert = as.numeric(n_cert),
    year   = as.integer(year)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(id, country, year, n_cert) %>%
  mutate(n_cert = ifelse(is.na(n_cert) & year == 1993, 0, n_cert))

# ── OECD CAPITALS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
capitals <- world.cities %>%
  filter(capital == 1) %>%
  mutate(country = case_when(
    country.etc == "UK" ~ "United Kingdom",
    country.etc == "USA" ~ "United States",
    country.etc == "Korea South" ~ "Korea",
    country.etc == "Slovakia" ~ "Slovak Republic",
    TRUE ~ country.etc
  )) %>%
  filter(country %in% oecd) %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  slice_max(pop, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(country)

# ── W GEO k=5 NN ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
coords <- as.matrix(capitals[, c("long", "lat")])
knn5 <- knearneigh(coords, k = 5)
nb5 <- knn2nb(knn5)
W_geo <- nb2mat(nb5, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

# ── W TRADE SIMILARITY (WDI) ──────────────────────────────────────────────

trade_raw <- read_csv("data/API_NE.TRD.GNFS.ZS_DS2_en_csv_v2_334.csv", skip = 4) %>%
  dplyr::select(country = `Country Name`, `1993`:`2017`) %>%
  pivot_longer(-country, names_to = "year", values_to = "trade") %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(year),
    country = case_match(
      country,
      "United States of America" ~ "United States",
      "Korea, Republic of" ~ "Korea",
      "Slovakia" ~ "Slovak Republic",
      .default = country
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(country %in% oecd)

make_W_trade <- function(yr, trade_df, countries) {
  tv <- trade_df %>%
    filter(year == yr, country %in% countries) %>%
    arrange(country) %>%
    filter(!is.na(trade))
  if (nrow(tv) < 20) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  vals <- tv$trade
  D <- outer(vals, vals, FUN = function(a, b) 1 / (1 + abs(a - b)))
  diag(D) <- 0
  rs <- rowSums(D)
  rs[rs == 0] <- 1
  list(W = D / rs, countries = tv$country)
}

# ── PANEL std Albuquerque ─────────────────────────────────────────────
panel <- iso9001 %>%
  filter(country %in% capitals$country) %>%
  arrange(country, year) %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  mutate(
    n_cert_lag = dplyr::lag(n_cert),
    new_cert   = n_cert - n_cert_lag,
    y_std      = new_cert / sqrt(pmax(n_cert_lag, 1))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(new_cert))
```



```{r}
#| label: sar-results-9001-OECD
#| echo: false

# ── SAR Coefficients ─────────────────────────────────────
extract_sar <- function(m) {
  s <- summary(m)
  rho_pval <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(m$rho / m$rho.se))
  tibble(
    rho = m$rho,
    rho_se = m$rho.se,
    rho_pval = rho_pval,
    rho_sig = case_when(
      rho_pval < 0.01 ~ "***",
      rho_pval < 0.05 ~ "**",
      rho_pval < 0.10 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )
}

# ── MOD 1: SAR GEO ─────────────────────────────────────────────
sar_geo <- purrr::map_dfr(sort(unique(panel$year)), function(y) {
  sub <- panel %>%
    filter(year == y) %>%
    arrange(country)
  if (nrow(sub) < 20) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  idx <- match(sub$country, capitals$country)
  W_sub <- W_geo[idx, idx]
  rs2 <- rowSums(W_sub)
  rs2[rs2 == 0] <- 1
  W_sub <- W_sub / rs2
  W_listw <- mat2listw(W_sub, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

  tryCatch(
    {
      m <- lagsarlm(y_std ~ 1, data = sub, listw = W_listw, zero.policy = TRUE)
      bind_cols(tibble(year = y, spec = "geographic"), extract_sar(m))
    },
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
})

# ── MOD 2: SAR TRADE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
sar_trade <- purrr::map_dfr(sort(unique(panel$year)), function(y) {
  res <- make_W_trade(y, trade_raw, oecd)
  if (is.null(res)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  sub <- panel %>%
    filter(year == y, country %in% res$countries) %>%
    arrange(country)
  if (nrow(sub) < 20) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  idx <- match(sub$country, res$countries)
  W_sub <- res$W[idx, idx]
  rs2 <- rowSums(W_sub)
  rs2[rs2 == 0] <- 1
  W_sub <- W_sub / rs2
  W_listw <- mat2listw(W_sub, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

  tryCatch(
    {
      m <- lagsarlm(y_std ~ 1, data = sub, listw = W_listw, zero.policy = TRUE)
      bind_cols(tibble(year = y, spec = "trade"), extract_sar(m))
    },
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
})
```

```{r}
#| label: sar-output-9001-OECD
#| echo: false
# ── RESULTS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
results <- bind_rows(sar_geo, sar_trade)
#print(results)

# ── PLOT ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
results %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = rho, color = spec, fill = spec)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = rho - 1.96 * rho_se, ymax = rho + 1.96 * rho_se),
    alpha = 0.2, color = NA
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_text(aes(label = rho_sig, y = rho + 0.05), size = 4, show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~spec) +
  labs(
    title = "SAR ISO 9001 OECD — peer effects",
    subtitle = "* p<0.10  ** p<0.05  *** p<0.01",
    x = "Year", y = expression(rho)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-2.5, 1.5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-2.5, 1.5, by = 0.5)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
#| label: mixed-9001-oecd
#| echo: false

row_norm <- function(W) {
  rs <- rowSums(W)
  rs[rs == 0] <- 1
  W / rs
}

sar_mixed <- purrr::map_dfr(sort(unique(panel$year)), function(y) {
  res <- make_W_trade(y, trade_raw, oecd) # <- cambia oecd/eu per ogni sezione
  if (is.null(res)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  common <- intersect(
    panel %>% filter(year == y) %>% pull(country),
    res$countries
  )
  sub <- panel %>%
    filter(year == y, country %in% common) %>%
    arrange(country)
  if (nrow(sub) < 20) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  idx_g <- match(sub$country, capitals$country)
  idx_t <- match(sub$country, res$countries)
  if (any(is.na(idx_g)) || any(is.na(idx_t))) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  W_mix <- 0.5 * row_norm(W_geo[idx_g, idx_g]) +
    0.5 * row_norm(res$W[idx_t, idx_t])
  W_mix <- row_norm(W_mix)
  W_list <- mat2listw(W_mix, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

  tryCatch(
    {
      m <- lagsarlm(y_std ~ 1, data = sub, listw = W_list, zero.policy = TRUE)
      bind_cols(tibble(year = y, spec = "mixed"), extract_sar(m))
    },
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
})

results_all <- bind_rows(sar_geo, sar_trade, sar_mixed)

results_all %>%
  filter(!is.na(rho_se)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = rho, color = spec, fill = spec)) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(
      ymin = rho - 1.96 * rho_se,
      ymax = rho + 1.96 * rho_se
    ),
    alpha = 0.15, color = NA
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_text(aes(label = rho_sig, y = rho + 0.07), size = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~spec) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    geographic = "#d6604d",
    trade = "#2166ac",
    mixed = "#4dac26"
  )) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    geographic = "#d6604d",
    trade = "#2166ac",
    mixed = "#4dac26"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "SAR ISO 9001 OECD — geographic, trade, mixed (0.5/0.5)",
    subtitle = "* p<0.10  ** p<0.05  *** p<0.01",
    x = "Year", y = expression(hat(rho))
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-2.5, 1.5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-2.5, 1.5, by = 0.5)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
```
```{r}
#| label: summary-stats-9001-oecd
#| echo: false

# Statistiche descrittive delle W per un anno rappresentativo (es. 2005)
yr_ref <- 2005

# W geo
idx_g  <- match(
  panel %>% filter(year == yr_ref) %>% arrange(country) %>% pull(country),
  capitals$country
)
idx_g  <- idx_g[!is.na(idx_g)]
W_g    <- row_norm(W_geo[idx_g, idx_g])

# W trade
res_t  <- make_W_trade(yr_ref, trade_raw, oecd)  # <- cambia oecd/eu
W_t    <- row_norm(res_t$W)

# W mixed
W_m    <- row_norm(0.5 * W_g[seq_len(nrow(W_t)), seq_len(nrow(W_t))] + 0.5 * W_t)

summarise_W <- function(W, name) {
  off <- W[upper.tri(W)]
  tibble(
    Network       = name,
    `Mean weight` = round(mean(off), 4),
    `SD weight`   = round(sd(off), 4),
    `Max weight`  = round(max(off), 4),
    `Sparsity`    = round(mean(off == 0), 3),
    `Avg degree`  = round(mean(rowSums(W > 0)), 1)
  )
}

bind_rows(
  summarise_W(W_g, "Geographic"),
  summarise_W(W_t, "Trade"),
  summarise_W(W_m, "Mixed (0.5/0.5)")
) %>%
  kbl(caption = "W descriptives, OECD (reference year: 2005)",
      booktabs = TRUE, align = "lccccc") %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position"), full_width = FALSE)

#| label: summary-stats-9001-eu

# Statistiche descrittive delle W per un anno rappresentativo (es. 2005)
yr_ref <- 2005

# W geo
idx_g  <- match(
  panel %>% filter(year == yr_ref) %>% arrange(country) %>% pull(country),
  capitals$country
)
idx_g  <- idx_g[!is.na(idx_g)]
W_g    <- row_norm(W_geo[idx_g, idx_g])

# W trade
res_t  <- make_W_trade(yr_ref, trade_raw, eu)  # <- cambia oecd/eu
W_t    <- row_norm(res_t$W)

# W mixed
W_m    <- row_norm(0.5 * W_g[seq_len(nrow(W_t)), seq_len(nrow(W_t))] + 0.5 * W_t)

summarise_W <- function(W, name) {
  off <- W[upper.tri(W)]
  tibble(
    Network       = name,
    `Mean weight` = round(mean(off), 4),
    `SD weight`   = round(sd(off), 4),
    `Max weight`  = round(max(off), 4),
    `Sparsity`    = round(mean(off == 0), 3),
    `Avg degree`  = round(mean(rowSums(W > 0)), 1)
  )
}

bind_rows(
  summarise_W(W_g, "Geographic"),
  summarise_W(W_t, "Trade"),
  summarise_W(W_m, "Mixed (0.5/0.5)")
) %>%
  kbl(caption = "W descriptives, EU (reference year: 2005)",
      booktabs = TRUE, align = "lccccc") %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position"), full_width = FALSE)
```
```{r}
#| label: 14001-analysis-oecd
#| echo: false

# ── ISO 14001 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
sheets <- c(4, 5, 6, 7, 8)
sheets_14001 <- purrr::map(sheets, ~ read_excel(
  "data/02. ISO 14001 - Number of certificates per country and industry sectors - 1999 to 2017.xlsm",
  sheet = .x
))

sheets_14001[[2]] <- sheets_14001[[2]] %>% slice(-(39:42))
sheets_14001[[4]] <- sheets_14001[[4]] %>% slice(-(36:40))
sheets_14001[[3]] <- sheets_14001[[3]] %>% dplyr::select(-21)
my_names <- c("country", as.character(1999:2017))

iso14001 <- purrr::map(1:5, ~ sheets_14001[[.x]] %>%
  slice(-(1:2)) %>%
  set_names(my_names) %>%
  pivot_longer(-country, names_to = "year", values_to = "n_cert")) %>%
  reduce(bind_rows) %>%
  mutate(country = case_match(country,
    "United States of America" ~ "United States",
    "Korea, Republic of" ~ "Korea",
    "Slovakia" ~ "Slovak Republic",
    .default = country
  )) %>%
  filter(country %in% oecd) %>%
  mutate(
    id     = as.integer(factor(country, levels = sort(unique(country)))),
    n_cert = as.numeric(n_cert),
    year   = as.integer(year)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(id, country, year, n_cert) %>%
  mutate(n_cert = ifelse(is.na(n_cert) & year == 1999, 0, n_cert))

# ── CAPITALI OCSE ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
capitals <- world.cities %>%
  filter(capital == 1) %>%
  mutate(country = case_when(
    country.etc == "UK" ~ "United Kingdom",
    country.etc == "USA" ~ "United States",
    country.etc == "Korea South" ~ "Korea",
    country.etc == "Slovakia" ~ "Slovak Republic",
    TRUE ~ country.etc
  )) %>%
  filter(country %in% oecd) %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  slice_max(pop, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(country)

# ── W GEOGRAFICA k=5 NN ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
coords <- as.matrix(capitals[, c("long", "lat")])
knn5 <- knearneigh(coords, k = 5)
nb5 <- knn2nb(knn5)
W_geo <- nb2mat(nb5, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

# ── W TRADE SIMILARITY (WDI) ──────────────────────────────────────────────

trade_raw <- read_csv("data/API_NE.TRD.GNFS.ZS_DS2_en_csv_v2_334.csv", skip = 4) %>%
  dplyr::select(country = `Country Name`, `1993`:`2017`) %>%
  pivot_longer(-country, names_to = "year", values_to = "trade") %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(year),
    country = case_match(
      country,
      "United States of America" ~ "United States",
      "Korea, Republic of" ~ "Korea",
      "Slovakia" ~ "Slovak Republic",
      .default = country
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(country %in% oecd)

make_W_trade <- function(yr, trade_df, countries) {
  tv <- trade_df %>%
    filter(year == yr, country %in% countries) %>%
    arrange(country) %>%
    filter(!is.na(trade))
  if (nrow(tv) < 20) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  vals <- tv$trade
  D <- outer(vals, vals, FUN = function(a, b) 1 / (1 + abs(a - b)))
  diag(D) <- 0
  rs <- rowSums(D)
  rs[rs == 0] <- 1
  list(W = D / rs, countries = tv$country)
}

# ── PANEL std Albuquerque ─────────────────────────────────────────────
panel <- iso14001 %>%
  filter(country %in% capitals$country) %>%
  arrange(country, year) %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  mutate(
    n_cert_lag = dplyr::lag(n_cert),
    new_cert   = n_cert - n_cert_lag,
    y_std      = new_cert / sqrt(pmax(n_cert_lag, 1))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(new_cert))

# ── SAR Coefficients ─────────────────────────────────────
extract_sar <- function(m) {
  s <- summary(m)
  rho_pval <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(m$rho / m$rho.se))
  tibble(
    rho = m$rho,
    rho_se = m$rho.se,
    rho_pval = rho_pval,
    rho_sig = case_when(
      rho_pval < 0.01 ~ "***",
      rho_pval < 0.05 ~ "**",
      rho_pval < 0.10 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )
}

# ── MOD 1: SAR GEO ─────────────────────────────────────────────
sar_geo <- purrr::map_dfr(sort(unique(panel$year)), function(y) {
  sub <- panel %>%
    filter(year == y) %>%
    arrange(country)
  if (nrow(sub) < 20) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  idx <- match(sub$country, capitals$country)
  W_sub <- W_geo[idx, idx]
  rs2 <- rowSums(W_sub)
  rs2[rs2 == 0] <- 1
  W_sub <- W_sub / rs2
  W_listw <- mat2listw(W_sub, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

  tryCatch(
    {
      m <- lagsarlm(y_std ~ 1, data = sub, listw = W_listw, zero.policy = TRUE)
      bind_cols(tibble(year = y, spec = "geographic"), extract_sar(m))
    },
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
})

# ── MOD 2: SAR TRADE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
sar_trade <- purrr::map_dfr(sort(unique(panel$year)), function(y) {
  res <- make_W_trade(y, trade_raw, oecd)
  if (is.null(res)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  sub <- panel %>%
    filter(year == y, country %in% res$countries) %>%
    arrange(country)
  if (nrow(sub) < 20) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  idx <- match(sub$country, res$countries)
  W_sub <- res$W[idx, idx]
  rs2 <- rowSums(W_sub)
  rs2[rs2 == 0] <- 1
  W_sub <- W_sub / rs2
  W_listw <- mat2listw(W_sub, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

  tryCatch(
    {
      m <- lagsarlm(y_std ~ 1, data = sub, listw = W_listw, zero.policy = TRUE)
      bind_cols(tibble(year = y, spec = "trade"), extract_sar(m))
    },
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
})

# ── RESULTS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
results <- bind_rows(sar_geo, sar_trade)
##print(results)

# ── PLOT ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
results %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = rho, color = spec, fill = spec)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = rho - 1.96 * rho_se, ymax = rho + 1.96 * rho_se),
    alpha = 0.2, color = NA
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_text(aes(label = rho_sig, y = rho + 0.05), size = 4, show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~spec) +
  labs(
    title = "SAR ISO 14001 OECD — peer effects geografici e trade",
    subtitle = "* p<0.10  ** p<0.05  *** p<0.01",
    x = "Year", y = expression(rho)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-2.5, 1.5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-2.5, 1.5, by = 0.5)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

W_geo <- nb2mat(nb5, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

# ── W TRADE SIMILARITY (WDI) ──────────────────────────────────────────────

trade_raw <- read_csv("data/API_NE.TRD.GNFS.ZS_DS2_en_csv_v2_334.csv", skip = 4) %>%
  dplyr::select(country = `Country Name`, `1993`:`2017`) %>%
  pivot_longer(-country, names_to = "year", values_to = "trade") %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(year),
    country = case_match(
      country,
      "United States of America" ~ "United States",

      "Slovakia" ~ "Slovak Republic",
      .default = country
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(country %in% oecd)

make_W_trade <- function(yr, trade_df, countries) {
  tv <- trade_df %>%
    filter(year == yr, country %in% countries) %>%
    arrange(country) %>%
    filter(!is.na(trade))
  if (nrow(tv) < 20) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  vals <- tv$trade
  D <- outer(vals, vals, FUN = function(a, b) 1 / (1 + abs(a - b)))
  diag(D) <- 0
  rs <- rowSums(D)
  rs[rs == 0] <- 1
  list(W = D / rs, countries = tv$country)
}

row_norm <- function(W) {
  rs <- rowSums(W)
  rs[rs == 0] <- 1
  W / rs
}

sar_mixed <- purrr::map_dfr(sort(unique(panel$year)), function(y) {
  res <- make_W_trade(y, trade_raw, oecd) # <- SET GEO
  if (is.null(res)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  common <- intersect(
    panel %>% filter(year == y) %>% pull(country),
    res$countries
  )
  sub <- panel %>%
    filter(year == y, country %in% common) %>%
    arrange(country)
  if (nrow(sub) < 20) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  idx_g <- match(sub$country, capitals$country)
  idx_t <- match(sub$country, res$countries)
  if (any(is.na(idx_g)) || any(is.na(idx_t))) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  W_mix <- 0.5 * row_norm(W_geo[idx_g, idx_g]) +
    0.5 * row_norm(res$W[idx_t, idx_t])

  W_list <- mat2listw(W_mix, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

  tryCatch(
    {
      m <- lagsarlm(y_std ~ 1, data = sub, listw = W_list, zero.policy = TRUE)
      bind_cols(tibble(year = y, spec = "mixed"), extract_sar(m))
    },
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
})

    ),

  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +

  facet_wrap(~spec) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    geographic = "#d6604d",
    trade = "#2166ac",
    mixed = "#4dac26"
  )) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    geographic = "#d6604d",
    trade = "#2166ac",
    mixed = "#4dac26"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "SAR ISO 14001 OECD — geographic, trade, mixed (0.5/0.5)",
    subtitle = "* p<0.10  ** p<0.05  *** p<0.01",
    x = "Year", y = expression(hat(rho))
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-2.5, 1.5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-2.5, 1.5, by = 0.5)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
